This launch introduces automated, PR-driven documentation that evolves with your repository. Instead of writing docs manually or letting them go stale, teams get: • Code-aware documentation generation • API and architecture documentation • Continuous updates as the codebase changes

records.name: Hearts Dating
records.tagline: The first-ever Pay-Per-Match dating app
records.description: Hearts is an alternative to freemium dating apps. All features on the app are free. When a user is interested in matching with another user, they can send them a typed message. The recipient is notified about the message but the content is blurred. The recipient is free to view the profile of the sender. If the recipient opens the message then both the sender and the recipient pay for 1 match. The sender can also recall the message anytime before the recipient has opened the message.

records.name: Basquiat
records.tagline: AI copilot to help build, edit & brainstorm Figma designs
records.description: Figma Make is powerful — but it doesn’t operate at the actual design file layer. Basquiat is an AI design agent that runs directly inside your Figma file and is all-hands. It can create, edit, organize, and refactor your real Figma layers: - Frames & Groups - Text Layers - Shapes & Rectangles - Components (including using existing library components) - Auto-layout, colors, strokes, spacing It's also local-first (bring-our-own-AI-API-key & save threads locally) & open-source.

records.name: Speechy
records.tagline: A site that turns your ideas into tasks
records.description: Turn hours of note taking into seconds. Record voice notes or upload recorded audio, and let the AI transcribe & structure them into actionable text. Create todo lists, notes, flashcards, transcripts, and more! Works in 100+ languages.

records.name: Competitor Keyword Finder
records.tagline: See what keywords any website ranks for. Free, no signup.
records.description: I have a paid competitor monitoring tool for SaaS founders. One of its features shows what keywords any website ranks for on Google. I pulled it out and made a free version anyone can use. Paste any URL and in seconds you get their top 10 ranking keywords with position, volume, and difficulty score. Real data, no guesses. No account, no credit card.

records.name: DataVapte
records.tagline: No *Good* Data Left Behind
records.description: DataVapte (Patent Pending) is the brainchild of Innovapte, an SAP-focused services and product innovator, built to solve the most persistent enterprise challenges in SAP data migration and data governance. The platform is founded on the ETVL-R framework Extract, Transform, Validate, Load, and Reconcile providing a structured, end-to-end approach to managing SAP data across S/4HANA migrations, M&A integrations, regulatory programs, and steady-state operations.

records.name: Logr
records.tagline: Track time. Manage clients. Get paid.
records.description: Freelancers juggle Toggl + Notion + Sheets + Trello. Logr replaces all of them. Time tracking (keyboard-first, Space to start/stop), client management, custom funnels (for job seekers and freelancers), funnel analytics with conversion rates, PDF invoices — all in one app. Built by a freelancer who got tired of paying $13/mo for a timer. 100% free, open-source (Apache 2.0). logr.work

records.name: ApplyCH
records.tagline: Save any job listing with AI. Auto-fill Swiss RAV forms.
records.description: Browse any job site — LinkedIn, jobs.ch, Indeed, or any company page — and click "Save." AI extracts job title, company, requirements & address instantly. ✦ Universal AI scraping — works on any website ✦ Cover letters in DE, FR, IT, EN with Swiss conventions ✦ One-click CV tailoring to match each job ✦ Auto-fills RAV proof-of-effort forms on job-room.ch ✦ CV PDF import with AI extraction Free: 10 saves/mo + RAV auto-fill Pro (CHF 9.99/mo): Unlimited + all AI features

records.name: Shamlatech
records.tagline: Powering the Future of Crypto Trading Platforms.
records.description: Cryptocurrency exchange development company to launch secure, scalable trading platforms fast 🚀 Reduce risk, ensure compliance & go live quicker!

records.name: QuarterBit AXIOM
records.tagline: Train 70B AI models on 1 GPU instead of 11
records.description: QuarterBit AXIOM makes large AI model training accessible to everyone. THE PROBLEM: Training a 70B parameter model needs 840GB of GPU memory — that's 11 A100 GPUs at $30+/hour. Only big tech can afford this. THE SOLUTION: AXIOM compresses training memory 15x, allowing: • 70B models on 1 GPU (was 11) • 13B models FREE on Kaggle T4 • 90% cost reduction • 91% energy reduction NOT LoRA OR ADAPTERS: 100% of parameters are trainable. Full fine-tuning, not parameter-efficient tricks.

records.name: PilotStack — Honest Software Comparisons
records.tagline: AI-powered software comparison pages
records.description: PilotStack helps you find the best software tools by comparing 100+ tools side by side — with detailed breakdowns, FAQs, and honest verdicts.

records.name: git-profile
records.tagline: Switch git identities per repo with one command
records.description: git commit as the right person, every time. Manage work, personal, and OSS git identities e.g., SSH keys, GPG signing, and auto-apply hooks in one CLI.

records.name: CoverMint
records.tagline: Upwork cover letters that mirror the client's requirements
records.description: Every Upwork job is different — your cover letter should be too. CoverMint turns job requirements and your profile into a concise, client-focused draft shaped around what matters in that specific project. It aligns your experience with the client’s needs, giving you structured positioning from the start. No overthinking. No scattered messaging. Just a clear draft you can refine and send with confidence.

records.name: Sell Bio
records.tagline: Turn one link into a full sales system from your bio.
records.description: Stop sending traffic to dead links. Create interactive funnels with conditional logic, capture leads, and sell — all from one bio link. No code. All in on with one platform (Link in bio, landing pages, forms). For creators, freelancers, coaches, and startups.

records.name: CuraMate
records.tagline: TELEMEDICINE, TRACK AND RUN
records.description: Get instant medical advice, track your wellness, and chat with specialized AI health experts 24/7. Your personal health companion powered by advanced AI technology.

records.name: Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite
records.tagline: Best-in-class intelligence for your high-volume workloads
records.description: Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite is the fastest and most cost-efficient model in the Gemini 3 series. At only $0.25 input and $1.50 output per million tokens, it beats 2.5 Flash with 2.5X faster first token and 45% higher output speed while matching or beating quality.

records.name: Blotta
records.tagline: Track your trades. Share with friends.
records.description: Blotta is a social investing app built around real trades. Connect your brokerage, share verified trades with friends, and see real performance in one clean feed. See what your friends are buying and how it's performing With Blotta you can: Share your thoughts, news and trades all in one feed. Climb the leaderboard Less noise. More signal. Invest better, together.

records.name: Joey MCP Client
records.tagline: Mobile MCP chat powered by OpenRouter
records.description: Joey is a chat app that lets you use hundreds of AI models with remote MCP servers. From your phone. Pick any model on OpenRouter, connect your MCP servers, and let the AI use real tools to get things done. Full MCP protocol support: tool calling, sampling, elicitation, OAuth, and session resumption. Most MCP clients today are desktop only. Joey runs natively on iOS, Android, and macOS. Built with Flutter. Source available on GitHub, or grab it from the App Store / Google Play.

records.name: Aback Launch
records.tagline: Launch your startup. Get discovered.
records.description: Aback Launch is a curated startup discovery platform where founders launch products, gain visibility, and earn SEO-friendly dofollow backlinks.

records.name: Intelisync
records.tagline: Intelisync – Web3 Development, Blockchain & Web3 Marketing
records.description: Performance-driven Web3 marketing, token launch strategy, AI-powered growth systems, and blockchain consulting for startups and enterprises. Book your demo.

records.name: InventoryPro – Stock Management System
records.tagline: InventoryPro – Smart Inventory & Stock Management System
records.description: InventoryPro is an all-in-one inventory, POS, and warehouse management platform built for growing businesses. Manage multi-branch stock, track sales in real time, generate smart reports, and automate purchase orders with ease. Featuring role-based access, barcode support, and a responsive dashboard, InventoryPro gives you complete control of your operations in one powerful, self-hosted solution.

records.name: Bookisty
records.tagline: The discovery platform for bookworms.
records.description: Browse the latest literary quotes shared by the Bookisty community. Discover new books through the words that stay with people.

records.name: PDF Converter
records.tagline: Fast & free PDF conversion — no login required
records.description: PDF Converter is a lightweight online tool designed to make document conversion simple and fast — without heavy software or complicated steps. ✨ Features: • Quick and smooth file conversion • Clean, distraction-free interface • No login required • Mobile friendly Built under Amza Solutions as part of a growing collection of practical micro web tools. Feedback is always welcome.

records.name: Esprit Code
records.tagline: Convert Figma designs to HTML/CSS instantly
records.description: Esprit Code converts your Figma designs into clean HTML/CSS with one click. It handles Auto Layout, Grid, masks, gradients, and multi-frame export — giving developers a solid foundation to build on, without the manual markup. Free plan available. No credit card required.

records.name: Bravey
records.tagline: Code at the speed of thought
records.description: Bravey Engineer is an AI software engineer that lives in your project management tool. Assign a ticket to Bravey in Linear or Jira, and it reads your codebase, implements the change, opens a pull request, and notifies your team on Slack — all in under 15 minutes.

records.name: Internal Newsletter
records.tagline: Internal newsletters your team will actually read
records.description: Creating internal newsletters for your team has always been a challenge, setting up email providers built for marketing sends, finding content, and then making it work in corporate clients. Internal Newsletter fixes all of that. Collect updates from your team, build with professional templates, and export email-ready HTML into your own email tools like Outlook or Gmail. No new vendor accessing your distribution lists, no Word document back and forths on content, just create and send.

records.name: curl2code
records.tagline: Instantly convert curl to code in 30+ languages — for free
records.description: Paste any curl command and get working code in Python, JavaScript, Go, PHP, Java, Rust, and 24 more languages — instantly in your browser. No signup, no limits. Runs locally via WebAssembly. Features: - cURL Builder: visually construct commands with auth, headers, body - AI Explain: BYOK to get plain-English explanations of curl - Smart Clean: strip unnecessary flags and normalize commands - 39 UI languages Built for devs tired of rewriting API examples from docs.

records.name: Notipo
records.tagline: Publish from Notion to WordPress, automatically
records.description: Write blog posts in Notion, publish to WordPress with a status change. Notipo handles everything automatically — images uploaded to your media library, featured images generated with Unsplash backgrounds, Rank Math SEO metadata, and code syntax highlighting. Draft first, publish when ready. Update posts by changing the status again. Categories and tags sync between WordPress and Notion. Open source, self-hostable with Docker, or use the hosted version with a free tier.

records.name: ZentithLLM
records.tagline: Run AI completely offline. No cloud. No tracking.
records.description: A powerful, offline-first AI applicationZentithLLM is an offline AI assistant that runs entirely on your device. No cloud. No API keys. No tracking. Download open models, chat locally, generate code, and experiment freely — all without an internet connection. for your device.

records.name: m8tes SDK
records.tagline: Ship autonomous agents to production in minutes
records.description: I made an SDK to create and deploy production-ready agents in a few lines: client = M8tes() teammate = client.teammates.create( name="revenue-report", instructions="Pull last week's Stripe charges, compare to the prior week, post a summary to #finance on Slack.", apps=["stripe", "slack"], schedule="every monday at 9am", ) Instantly you have a sandboxed agent running with apps, scheduler, email inbox, memory, etc. You set it up once and it runs without you.

records.name: SchemaMind
records.tagline: The GPT for enterprise data - unified datasets, instantly
records.description: SchemaMind is the world's first Generative Data Intelligence platform. Unlike ETL tools or semantic layers, it's the AI mind that thinks across ALL your structured sources — SQL databases, Excel files, CSVs, and PDFs — and returns one unified, perfect dataset. No warehouse. No data engineers. No manual schema mapping. Just ask in plain English. Like GPT did for text, SchemaMind does for enterprise data.

records.name: Fluent Forms
records.tagline: Simple form builder with voice fill & collaboration features
records.description: Fluent Forms is an AI-powered checksheet and form platform built for field workers who need fast, reliable data capture on the job. • Create checksheets using simple language • Complete inspections quickly on mobile • Voice-to-form data capture • Standardise safety & compliance checks • Reduce paperwork and admin time • Instant reports and structured records

records.name: Fabaverse
records.tagline: Your thoughts as stars, dreams as symbols, goals as planets
records.description: Fabaverse turns your mind into a 3D universe. 🌟 NYX: Thoughts as glowing stars. 🌙 ONEIROS: Jungian dream analysis via Gemini AI. ☀️ HEMERA: Goals orbiting like planets. ⚔️ HERACLES: Action Forge. Tasks as divine mandates. 🤖 ASTHER: AI companion with memory in YOUR database. 💨 ECHO: Nervous system calibration. 👁️ EREBUS: Shadow work detecting avoidance. 🧠 ATHENA: High-level strategic insights. Built by a mechatronics engr to solve cognitive scattering through industrial-grade architecture.

records.name: BenchWatch
records.tagline: Clean NBA injury reports and alerts for teams you care about
records.description: Keeping track of who's in or out before tip-off is more annoying than it should be. Injury data is scattered across bloated sports apps and hard to check quickly. BenchWatch pulls the official NBA injury report, cleans it up, and shows you a simple view of who's playing for each game. Updates every 30 minutes. Subscribe to teams you care about and get notified when a player's status changes. Free, no ads, no account required. Just built it because I wanted it to exist.

records.name: Bingo Jam
records.tagline: Retro bingo with mini-games, city building & leaderboards
records.description: Bingo Jam is a retro 60s/70s USA travel bingo game built around constant competition. You play classic bingo, jump into dice-based mini-games (like board-game style races), climb leaderboards, and even build your own retro city! The game is packed with beautiful collections, fun easter eggs, and nods to classic movies. It’s truly free-to-play with no hard paywalls. You only use optional IAPs if you want to speed up progress.

records.name: QuickClause
records.tagline: AI legal document generator. Generate India legal agreements
records.description: India's #1 AI legal document generator. Create professional contracts, agreements & legal documents in minutes. 500+ Indian law templates, automated compliance verification, legal clause library. Start free - used by 2500+ professionals!

records.name: Lumepixa
records.tagline: Turn phone snaps into store-ready product photos with AI
records.description: Replace professional product photography with AI. Snap a photo, pick a platform preset (Amazon, Shopify, Etsy, eBay, Walmart, TikTok Shop...), and get store-ready images in about a minute. No studio needed. 13 platform presets with correct dimensions and backgrounds. 22 lifestyle scene backgrounds. Web portal for desktop management. 19 languages. No subscription — pay-per-photo credits that never expire. 3 free credits on signup.

records.name: Human Page
records.tagline: Social media w/ proof you're human, w/o proving who you are
records.description: Human Page is a social app where every user is verified as a real human being, without collecting biometrics or personal information. We verify that someone is a real person without needing to know who they are. No iris scan. No orbs. No identity data. The result is an app where you can trust that every person is real, and no one, including us, knows anything about them. No bots. No AI profiles. No algorithm. Just humans. Human Page is currently free on the App Store. We're building in public.

records.name: BookItUp
records.tagline: Your personal library manager, right in your pocket
records.description: BookItUp is a clean, private Personal Library Manager — no ads, no tracking, not owned by Amazon. Scan any book barcode to instantly add it to your library, track reading status, set goals, write reviews, and share your shelf with friends. Add household members for a fully shared family library. Verified tracking-free by Blacklight. Free forever for up to 100 books — no credit card, ever.

records.name: Smooth Operator: Convo Coach
records.tagline: Practice hard conversations before they matter
records.description: Most people wing their most important conversations. Smooth Operator lets you rehearse them first. Practice salary negotiations, tough confrontations, and high-stakes moments with an AI coach that adapts to what you say, pushes back like a real person, and tells you exactly how you come across. — Text or voice mode — Scored across 9 communication dimensions — Real-time feedback after every exchange Stop panicking. Start preparing.

records.name: Vocova
records.tagline: Transcribe audio & video from 1,000+ platforms
records.description: Vocova transcribes audio and video to text in 100+ languages. Paste a link from YouTube, TikTok, Zoom, or 1,000+ platforms — or upload any file. What makes it different: - Speaker identification with color-coded labels and timestamps - Translate transcripts to 145+ languages with bilingual side-by-side view - Edit transcripts directly in the browser - Export as PDF, DOCX, SRT, VTT, TXT, or CSV - AI summaries and Q&A extraction Free to start, no credit card required.

records.name: Hexgate
records.tagline: Real-time item builds for LoL based on enemy team comp
records.description: Hexgate is a free real-time desktop overlay for League of Legends that recommends optimal items based on enemy team composition. Data-driven builds from millions of ranked games. One-click rune import, lane matchup scoring, and OTP builds.

records.name: Master Global Time
records.tagline: Compare timezones easily!
records.description: Visually compare timezones and find the perfect meeting times with our interactive slider. Fast and simple.

records.name: Find Cheap Streaming
records.tagline: Compare Streaming Providers
records.description: Find the best cheap streaming services in 2026. Compare prices, features, and reviews of top platforms like Netflix, Disney+, & more.

records.name: DingTalk
records.tagline: DingTalk is AI-enhanced workspace
records.description: AI-powered all-in-one workplace platform. Chat, HD video meetings, docs, task management & automated workflows for secure, scalable global team collaboration.

records.name: Gantt Chart Pro
records.tagline: Create beautiful Gantt charts in seconds - Free forever!
records.description: GanttChartPro is a fast, modern way to create beautiful Gantt charts without the complexity of traditional PM tools. Add tasks, set dependencies, adjust timelines, collaborate with zero learning curve. Go fully local with zero data uploaded, keeping sensitive info private. Enjoy a generous free tier, flexible licenses including a lifetime license (don't we all hate subscriptions?) and a tool that makes presentation ready beautiful Gantt Charts fast, and worry-free.

records.name: Crie provas profissionais em minutos
records.tagline: AI-powered exam gen aligned with Brazil's BNCC curriculum
records.description: GeraProva é a plataforma de IA que cria provas e questões educacionais alinhadas à BNCC em segundos. Objetivas, dissertativas, com gabarito automático. Grátis para professores.
